messages:
elaine (People Ops): Heads up — candidate accepted verbally for Senior Infra Eng (remote). Manager requested a split sign-on (50% on start, 50% at 6 months) and a comp-band exception +$10k above band cap. Need routing for approvals.
samuel (Recruiter): Thanks. Candidate is on target to start 2026-04-20. Willing to wait for approvals but prefers earlier paperwork. @jorge can confirm business rationale.
jorge (Hiring Manager): Yep — critical project ramp. Budgeted for senior hire but this candidate has competing offer. Split sign-on needed to close them. Happy to sign off on performance milestones.
liza (Comp & Benefits): Policy: split sign-ons are allowed but require approval from Comp and the Finance approver when above band. For +$10k over comp band we need manager justification + director ok. Please include proposed total OTE and justification.
elaine (People Ops): Copying process: 1) Manager justification doc -> attach here. 2) Comp review (liza). 3) Finance approval -> payroll-bot will create approval ticket. 4) Offer letter updated with split schedule. 5) Start date confirmation.
samuel (Recruiter): Attaching short justification: "candidate has specialty infra expertise, 2 competing offers, critical to Q2 launch". Proposed comp: base 165k, target band cap 155k, sign-on 20k split 10/10 at start/6mo.
jorge (Hiring Manager): +1. Also ok to include 3-month performance checkpoint as Milestone A for second half of sign-on.
liza (Comp & Benefits): Received justification. Quick check: base +10k exceeds band cap. Will need Director comp approval. I can route to Director @marta now. Also confirm the sign-on split language — legal needs to review clause for clawback if employee leaves before 6mo.
elaine (People Ops): I'll loop Legal after Comp signs off. @payroll-bot can you open a Finance approval ticket referencing thread 1837599999 and the total comp delta?
payroll-bot: Ticket FIN-2026-311 created -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2026-311. Please add final approved amounts and attach offer.
samuel (Recruiter): Thanks bot. I'll hold the formal offer until approvals done, but will send verbal timeline to candidate: offer pending approvals; target day-of-offer 2026-04-02.
jorge (Hiring Manager): If Director approves today we can move faster. Marta, ping?
elaine (People Ops): FYI — if Director requires alternatives, we can propose 5k sign-on + 5k retention bonus at 12mo. That keeps above-band impact lower upfront.
liza (Comp & Benefits): Noted. Routing to Director Marta now. Will update thread when she responds.
marta (Director of Comp): Reviewing. Can we get a brief list of comparable comps (internal peers) and the critical skill justification? If so, I can provisionally approve the +10k and sign-off later today.
samuel (Recruiter): Adding internal peer comps in the ticket now and re-attaching the justification doc.
marta (Director of Comp): Ok — provisional approve +10k and split sign-on contingent on legal clawback language and Finance final sign-off. :thumbsup:
elaine (People Ops): Great — next steps: Legal review (ETA 24h), Finance final sign-off on FIN-2026-311 (ETA 48h), then we generate formal offer PDF with split sign-on schedule. I'll update candidate timeline accordingly.
jorge (Hiring Manager): Thanks everyone. If legal clears today we can send by 04/02 per Samuel's timeline.
samuel (Recruiter): I'll message candidate with "expect formal offer this week pending final finance/legal approvals". Thanks!
elaine (People Ops): Closing loop once offer sent. Adding checklist: approved_comp_delta, legal_clause, payroll_ticket, offer_pdf, signed_acceptance. :white_check_mark:
